text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway
on my way to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—40 minutes and 30 seconds have passed.
Scarlet, let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's already this late.
...I'm sorry, I was having trouble solving the formula.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
I've calculated everything into the schedule: attention span, weak question tendencies, and all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to rush, everything is fine.
At this rate, we'll cover the entire test scope.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san...
Truly, thank you for everything, as always.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, not at all.
You understand what I teach you right away, so it's rewarding and fun for me too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
2 minutes and 34 seconds have passed. Prepare to resume.
If you try once more, you'll surely get the hang of—
Are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
I happened to overhear your conversation while looking something up.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! Tachyon-san.
...What do you mean, 'how about it'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We were just talking about how her bad habits
might be showing again. Just the other day, too—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Scarlet-kun.
Today's research byproduct is this hair treatment, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Dullness around the orbicularis oculi muscle.
Edema in the upper arms and around the zygomaticus major muscle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It seems what you really needed before the exam was a sofa in a dim, quiet room for a good rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san!? I thought we agreed to keep that confidential—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In other words, you were studying outside of your scheduled hours, and cutting into your sleep to do so?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Urk! ...I-I'm sorry... I just thought I had
to get 1st place this time too... and, um...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I am the one who should apologize.
Even though it was my place to guide and teach you, I failed to properly understand you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I must ask Tachyon-san. About the Scarlet-san that I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll readjust our schedule based on that
and aim for even greater efficiency!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-What!?
You want to hear more of my pathetic stories!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You!
You're Flash's Trainer, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If you could somehow persuade them, um... Flash-san's burden would be lightened, and I don't think it would affect her practice!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Please don't stop me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Grasping your target increases efficiency.
As an instructor, you should understand this as well.
choice_data_list: There's a way to get this done quickly.
There's a way to get this done quickly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Grasping your target increases efficiency.
As an instructor, you should understand this as well.
choice_data_list: There's a way to get this done quickly.
There's a way to get this done quickly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Meaning?
choice_data_list: How about you and I teach them together, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see, indeed.
If they possess knowledge I lack, can handle the situation well, and can double the amount taught...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Personally, having two teachers
around feels super reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall rearrange the schedule immediately.
It will only take 1 minute and 15 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind helping to that extent, but... Flash-kun, I have an experiment scheduled after this."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If I had some guarantee that an experiment equivalent
to the one we can't do today is possible...
I feel like I'd be able to put more heart into it, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case... Tachyon-san, what do you think about what we discussed yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho! You're willing to assist with my
'Theoretical Treatise on Discrepancies Between Internal Clock and Real Time'?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Schedule reconfiguration complete.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll spend five minutes explaining the example problem.
After that, Tachyon-san will present an applied problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be in your care!
It looks like Eishin Flash is in for a fulfilling time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado, let's have Tachyon-san
share the "bad tendencies" of Scarlet-san
that she is aware of.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-But still!?
Don't you think that's a waste of time?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Both data collection and error correction
can be executed within 1 hour and 10 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because it will improve efficiency compared to now, there won't be any delays to the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind helping to that extent, but... Flash-kun, I have an experiment scheduled after this."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If I had some guarantee that an experiment equivalent
to the one we can't do today is possible...
I feel like I'd be able to put more heart into it, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case... Tachyon-san, what do you think about what we discussed yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho! You're willing to assist with my
'Theoretical Treatise on Discrepancies Between Internal Clock and Real Time'?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get down to aligning our plans right away.
The sooner we tackle our challenges, the better!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how things would turn out...
but I'm glad it seems I'll be able to help you even more.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-It's not fine at all...!!
...It looks like Eishin Flash is going to have a wonderfully fulfilling time!
